name: Skillcast Group plc
summary: Skillcast Group plc offers specialized compliance training services for staff, operating across the United Kingdom, Malta, and internationally. Their portfolio includes pre-built compliance courses and bespoke e-learning solutions. A cornerstone offering is their fully managed Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) Learning Management System (LMS), which enables companies to develop and disseminate digital educational content. They also provide Policy Hub, an online platform for efficient corporate policy management, and Training 360, a solution designed to record in-person training sessions, mentoring, and consultations. Additional services feature event management tools, the technology-driven SMCR 360 software, data integration solutions, and various Regtech instruments aimed at managing diverse compliance requirements. Incorporated in 2019, Skillcast Group plc is based in London, UK.
